name: Nebius SWE-rebench OpenHands trajectories
use: Agentic coding request histories: system prompts, function tools and tool output.
handling: AgentBench takes a seeded sample, trims messages to client-sent fields and retains source record identifiers in private corpus metadata.
status: Bundled in the default AgentBench corpus

name: Novita Agentic Code Dataset 22
use: Recorded Claude Code API requests, including main and side-agent calls, timestamps and output sizes.
handling: AgentBench converts the OpenAI-format export, skips failed recorded requests and records repeated sessions in the mixture metadata.
status: Bundled in the default AgentBench corpus

name: Allen AI WildChat-1M
contributor: Allen Institute for AI and the WildChat authors
use: Real chat conversations without tools, representing the chat slice of a mixed population.
handling: AgentBench keeps message role and content, drops location, hashed IP and browser headers, and excludes conversations marked toxic by default.
status: Bundled in the default AgentBench corpus

name: Trace Commons Agent Traces
license: CC BY 4.0 compilation; embedded material may retain separate terms
use: Timing only: tool-execution gaps and human think-time distributions for sources without timestamps.
handling: AgentBench stores derived gap quantiles, not Trace Commons session content. The upstream warns that anonymization is best-effort and that embedded code or content may have separate licenses.

name: Thoughtworks Agentic Coding Trajectories
contributor: Thoughtworks and its three upstream dataset communities
license: Per-row upstream terms; no blanket dataset license
use: Optional text-tool-protocol trajectories from SWE-agent and Klear sources.
handling: AgentBench records each row's source dataset and terms. Consumers must select a compatible subset and follow every applicable upstream policy.
status: Supported importer; not in the bundled default mix

name: SWE-bench Pro
contributor: Scale AI and the upstream open-source repositories
license: MIT harness; task content retains upstream repository licenses
revision: External dataset revision must be pinned for a reproducible run
use: Optional issue-fix task generation and patch grading in isolated repository containers.
handling: AgentBench samples tasks deterministically and invokes an external grading harness. This path is separate from replay-only serving measurements.

name: Kilo Code
revision: Prompt-pack client version is recorded; an exact upstream source revision is not established
use: A captured Kilo-like prompt pack and client-behavior profile for synthetic agent replay.
handling: The bundled prompt pack is a benchmarking fixture, not a claim of current Kilo behavior. Public studies must identify when this fixture is used.
status: Optional synthetic replay fixture; provenance review required before redistribution

name: tau-bench
revision: External tool version must be pinned by the run
use: Optional external generator for tool-agent-user evaluation sessions.
handling: AgentBench wraps the external CLI; tau-bench tasks, policies and generated outputs are not part of the default serving corpus.

name: llama-benchy
revision: Conceptual reference; no source code is vendored
use: Methodological reference for prompt-processing and token-generation probes at multiple context depths.
handling: AgentBench implements its own measurement and coherence paths; this credit identifies the documented methodological influence.
